title: Zero to RAG (CosmosDB as Vector Store)

cues.en: Hi, in this companion video to my Zero to Rack mini-series, where in the main video
cues.zh: 大家好，這是 Zero to RAG 迷你系列的補充影片。主影片中，

cues.en: I went through every single step on how to go from absolutely zero to having an agent
cues.zh: 我示範了每一個步驟，從完全沒有設定開始，一直到建立能夠，

cues.en: that could search a rack, we are now going to cover how to switch that in-memory database that we use there into a Cosmos DB.
cues.zh: 使用 RAG 搜尋的代理程式。現在要介紹，如何將當時使用的記憶體資料庫改成 Cosmos DB。

cues.en: So Cosmos DB is a little more involved than some of the other ones, but not too, too much.
cues.zh: Cosmos DB 比其他幾種儲存區稍微複雜一點，但也不會多太多。

cues.en: So because this is a Zero to Rack, meaning we need to do everything, I'm going to create a brand new Cosmos DB up here.
cues.zh: 既然是 Zero to RAG，代表整套流程都要示範，所以我會先建立全新的 Cosmos DB。

cues.en: So up in Azure, in my sandbox, I'm going to make a Cosmos DB, and spell it.
cues.zh: 進到 Azure，在 Sandbox 裡新增 Cosmos DB。先把名稱拼對。

cues.en: And in my case, when we use the Cosmos DB here, I'm going to use the Cosmos DB for NoSQL.
cues.zh: 這個例子會使用 Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL。

cues.en: There's the Mongo version, and there's two different NuGet packages, one for CERT that works with both.
cues.zh: 另外也有 MongoDB 版本，對應的 NuGet 套件也有兩種，分別支援不同類型。

cues.en: But we're going to do NoSQL, workload type is just learning here, it's going to go away just after this record.
cues.zh: 這裡選 NoSQL，工作負載類型只用於學習，這個資源錄完影片後就會刪除。

cues.en: And I look at the Tube, Availability Zones, we don't care, we don't care really about
cues.zh: 名稱用 YouTube。可用性區域這裡不重要，位置也沒有特別，

cues.en: the location, and I'm going to go serverless so it costs less, because I'm already using my free TR account.
cues.zh: 要求。我會選 Serverless，費用比較低，因為我的免費層帳戶已經用在其他地方。

cues.en: But we're just going to make it here, and that will take a little while, so I will pause the video and come back to you once it's ready.
cues.zh: 先建立資源，這需要一點時間。我會暫停影片，等準備好再回來。

cues.en: Okay, it took a couple of minutes, but the resource is now ready.
cues.zh: 好，過了幾分鐘，資源已經就緒。

cues.en: So let's go to it, and now Data Explorer, we're going to make a new database, so let's
cues.zh: 進到資源，再到 Data Explorer 建立資料庫，

cues.en: just call it YouTube.
cues.zh: 名稱就叫 YouTube。

cues.en: And different from some of the others that automatically create the table or index or
cues.zh: 與其他會自動建立資料表或索引的儲存區不同，

cues.en: so on up in Cosmos, we also need to make the container that it goes into because of the partition keys.
cues.zh: Cosmos DB 還需要先建立容器，因為涉及分割區索引鍵。

cues.en: So we're going to make the container as well, we're going to call it MyCollection, so it
cues.zh: 所以也要建立 Container，這裡取名為 MyCollection，它，

cues.en: needs to match the name we put in for our code.
cues.zh: 必須與程式碼中指定的名稱一致。

cues.en: And then there's the partition key.
cues.zh: 接著是 Partition key，也就是分割區索引鍵。

cues.en: Right now we only have an ID, a question and answer, and a vector, none of them really fit a partition key.
cues.zh: 目前只有 ID、問題、答案和向量，其實都不是很理想的分割區索引鍵。

cues.en: I imagine if you're looking for this in Cosmos, you definitely know what Cosmos partition
cues.zh: 如果你正在研究 Cosmos DB，應該已經知道 Cosmos 的分割區，

cues.en: keys are, but nothing really fits, so I'm going to do the stupid thing and do it on the ID.
cues.zh: 索引鍵是什麼。但這裡沒有很適合的欄位，所以我先採取最簡單的做法，使用 ID。

cues.en: But in real life, if you're really onto Cosmos anyway, you'll probably have some kind of type or region or something to put into the partition key.
cues.zh: 實際應用中，如果原本就有使用 Cosmos，通常會有類型、區域等欄位，可以用來當分割區索引鍵。

cues.en: It needs to match one of the properties that we have down in our vector here, so I'm just
cues.zh: 它必須對應到下方向量資料模型中的某個屬性，所以我就，

cues.en: matching it against this one.
cues.zh: 對應這個屬性。

cues.en: So let's go in and create that container, and then we should be ready.
cues.zh: 接著建立容器，應該就準備好了。

cues.en: We have it, we of course need to get our keys, and while we're waiting for this, I'm going to expose my keys now, my connection string.
cues.zh: 建立完成後，當然需要取得金鑰。等候的同時，我會展示金鑰與連線字串。

cues.en: That's because whenever you see this video, this resource has already been removed again,
cues.zh: 原因是你看到這支影片時，這個資源已經刪除了，

cues.en: so it's not a security risk for me, but of course you should never share things like this.
cues.zh: 所以對我而言沒有安全風險。但你當然不應該分享這些資訊。

cues.en: And what we're in is in a sample that looks just like the in-memory one, but we just have
cues.zh: 現在這個範例與 InMemory 版本相同，只是多了一個，

cues.en: a place to put in a connection string, so we're going to put that in.
cues.zh: 填入連線字串的位置，我們把它貼上。

cues.en: In order for us to work with it, we need one of the other packages in our vector data for community toolkits, so we're going to go to NuGet.
cues.zh: 要操作這個儲存區，需要 CommunityToolkit.VectorData 的另一個套件，所以進到 NuGet。

cues.en: We already have the in-memory, we could take that away.
cues.zh: 原本有 InMemory 套件，現在可以移除。

cues.en: And because of Cosmos, we have also put in Newtonsoft.json, because else it complains about not having that.
cues.zh: 由於使用 Cosmos，我也加入了 Newtonsoft.Json，否則系統會抱怨缺少這個套件。

cues.en: It's a little annoying, but that's just the way it is, and it would tell you if you didn't already put it in.
cues.zh: 雖然有點麻煩，但目前就是如此。如果沒有事先加入，執行時也會提醒。

cues.en: So we can put in community toolkit.vectordata, and among these, you can see there's two Cosmos,
cues.zh: 搜尋 CommunityToolkit.VectorData，可以看到有兩個 Cosmos 套件，

cues.en: one if we use NoSQL, and one if we use MongoDB, because there's different APIs for them.
cues.zh: 一個對應 NoSQL，另一個對應 MongoDB，因為使用的 API 不同。

cues.en: We of course use the ones we created at last, the NoSQL.
cues.zh: 我們當然選剛才建立的 NoSQL。

cues.en: So that is ready, and the only thing we need to do now is to switch out our in-memory vector
cues.zh: 準備好之後，現在唯一需要做的，是把這裡原本的 InMemory 向量，

cues.en: store here with the Cosmos DB vector store.
cues.zh: 儲存區替換成 Cosmos DB 向量儲存區。

cues.en: This one has a bit extra, so we need the connection string, but we also need here already to tell the database name, because it's not part of the connection string.
cues.zh: 這個版本多了一些設定：除了連線字串，還需要事先指定資料庫名稱，因為它不包含在連線字串裡。

cues.en: So I think I called it YouTube, didn't I? Let's check.
cues.zh: 我剛才應該取名為 YouTube，對吧？確認一下。

cues.en: Yeah, YouTube.
cues.zh: 沒錯，是 YouTube。

cues.en: We also need a Cosmos client options, so we need a new of that.
cues.zh: 另外也需要一個 CosmosClientOptions，所以新增它。

cues.en: And the thing we need to set here is use system text JSON serialization with options.
cues.zh: 這裡必須設定使用 System.Text.Json 序列化，以及對應的選項。

cues.en: If we don't tell that, it will complain saying, hey, you need to set this.
cues.zh: 如果沒有指定，系統會提示必須設定。

cues.en: And we can say our JSON serialization options, and I know the web defaults work fine.
cues.zh: 接著傳入 JsonSerializerOptions，我知道使用 Web 預設值就能正常運作。

cues.en: Beyond that, we need the Cosmos DB vector store options in order to give our link.
cues.zh: 另外需要 Cosmos DB 向量儲存區選項，用來提供嵌入生成器。

cues.en: But beyond that, we don't need to change anything.
cues.zh: 除此之外，不需要再修改任何東西。

cues.en: That's all we need.
cues.zh: 只要這些就夠了。

cues.en: We can run it, and hopefully it will work.
cues.zh: 執行看看，希望能成功。

cues.en: It begins embedding.
cues.zh: 開始產生嵌入向量了。

cues.en: And once the embedding is done, our AI will of course answer, just like we did in the main video.
cues.zh: 嵌入完成之後，AI 當然就會像主影片一樣回答問題。

cues.en: And if we look up in Cosmos, we should be able to look at the items here,
cues.zh: 到 Cosmos 裡查看，應該能在 Items 這裡看到資料，

cues.en: which is our 10 different Q&A questions with the vector as well.
cues.zh: 也就是十筆不同的問答，以及各自的向量。

cues.en: So the Q, the A, and the vector.
cues.zh: 所以包含問題、答案和向量。

cues.en: And that's actually everything there is to it.
cues.zh: 其實全部內容就是這樣。

cues.en: Cosmos requires a little more setup here, a bit more annoying, the partition key.
cues.zh: Cosmos 需要多做一點設定，分割區索引鍵也比較麻煩，

cues.en: But beyond that, we don't need to change a single line of code from the main video.
cues.zh: 但除此之外，主影片中的程式碼不需要另外修改。

cues.en: So with that, thank you. See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 以上，謝謝，我們下一支影片再見。
